content:
maria: Heads-up — thinking about a refactor for onboarding sampling + drift hooks. Need to land tradeoffs for bench coverage vs cost. Who's around?
aj: I'm +1 for stratified sampling by seqlen and prompt-type, helps catch perf regressions tied to tail cases.
sachin: Can we piggyback on the golden-sampler infra? running new flows will be costly if we duplicate.
leo: Sketch: sample N per bucket per model version, run mini-bench (latency + p50/p95/token cost), and a lightweight goldset eval for quality regressions.
maria: Proposal: three gating stages — smoke (fast), perf (mini-bench), quality (goldset). Smoke should be <2s wall for obvious incompat/manifest issues.
aj: Q: where do drift hooks live? admission path or async post-deploy? Admission catches early but can slow iteration.
sachin: I'd do admission hard-fails for obvious incompat (tokenizer mismatch, model load errors), but async post-deploy for soft quality drifts with alerts and auto-rollback policies.
maria: Sounds right. Need clear interface boundaries: Onboard API returns a minimal gate_status + reasons and artifact links. Fields: pass/fail, stage, reasons[], artifacts_url.
leo: Example config snippet: ```json
{"smoke_window_s":5, "mini_bench_samples":50, "goldset_eval":true}
```
aj: Also add KV/cache compatibility smoke: run warmup with seqlen sweep (1,8,64,256) and check cache hit-rate / kv size deltas.
probe-bot: Reminder: Organization policy — default run_limits for mini-bench is 10m per model. Overrides require eng-ml approval.
maria: Next steps: I'll open a short RFC with the API contract, the sampling plan, and a cost estimate. @aj @sachin please add perf constraints and golden-set sizing. Anything else?
sachin: Add a canary fallback policy: route 5% of traffic to previous model for 24h if goldset delta > threshold, and automatic rollback when latency or quality regresses exceed SLOs.
leo: +1. Also add telemetry tags: onboard.model, onboard.run_id, sample_bucket, bench.run_time.
aj: I'll mock a Datadog dashboard with sampling coverage, p95 delta, and goldset metric delta.
maria: Thanks — I'll post the RFC link once created. :slightly_smiling_face:
